title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 019 ]

blocks.text: An Eskimo once told European visitors that the only true wisdom lives far from mankind, out in the great loneliness, and can be reached only through suffering. The great loneliness―like the loneliness a caterpillar endures when she wraps herself in a silky cocoon and begins the long transformation to butterfly. It seems that we too must go through such a time, when life as we have known it is over and yet we don’t know who we are supposed to become. All we know is that something bigger is calling us to change. And though we must make the journey alone, and even if suffering is our only companion, soon enough we will become a butterfly, soon enough we will taste the joy of being alive.

readingSentences.english: An Eskimo once told European visitors that the only true wisdom lives far from mankind, out in the great loneliness, and can be reached only through suffering.
readingSentences.korean: 한 에스키모인이 유럽에서 온 방문객들에게, 유일한 참된 지혜는 인간에게서 멀리 떨어진 거대한 고독 속에 살며 고통을 통해서만 이를 수 있다고 말한 적이 있다.

readingSentences.english: The great loneliness―like the loneliness a caterpillar endures when she wraps herself in a silky cocoon and begins the long transformation to butterfly.
readingSentences.korean: 거대한 고독이란, 애벌레가 비단 같은 고치로 몸을 감싸고 나비가 되는 긴 변화를 시작할 때 견디는 외로움과 같다.

readingSentences.english: It seems that we too must go through such a time, when life as we have known it is over and yet we don’t know who we are supposed to become.
readingSentences.korean: 우리가 알아 온 삶은 끝났지만 아직 우리가 어떤 사람이 되어야 할지 모르는, 그런 시기를 우리도 겪어야 하는 것 같다.

readingSentences.english: All we know is that something bigger is calling us to change.
readingSentences.korean: 우리가 아는 것은 더 큰 무언가가 우리에게 변하라고 부르고 있다는 것뿐이다.

readingSentences.english: And though we must make the journey alone, and even if suffering is our only companion, soon enough we will become a butterfly, soon enough we will taste the joy of being alive.
readingSentences.korean: 비록 그 여정을 혼자 가야 하고 고통이 유일한 동반자일지라도, 머지않아 우리는 나비가 되고, 머지않아 살아 있다는 기쁨을 맛보게 될 것이다.
